description: A whole video at once from a plan (the shape video_plan returns: title, brief, aspect_ratio, style, presenter, shots). Give the `plan` as JSON, or a `path` on this machine (a zip with plan.json and the files it names as file:…, a plan.json with those files beside it, or the folder holding them), or a `url` to such a zip or plan.json. Footage, voice tracks and icons the plan names are uploaded first (in chunks, any size), then the plan is imported with their media ids.

company.description: the company id (list_companies); not needed when you have one company, asked for otherwise

path.description: a zip, a plan.json or a folder on this machine

url.description: a link to a zip or plan.json

name: import_video_plan
title: Import a video plan
